title: Do this in every ad you make, and you’ll crush it. 🔥
description: Do this in every ad you make, and you’ll crush it. 🔥
transcript: What are the key components of every strong ad? So the first part is it's gotta grab people's attention. If it doesn't grab their attention, then nothing else is gonna work. Then it's gotta hold their attention. So it's either gotta talk to a pain point they've got. It's gotta generate some curiosity. It's gotta really engage them. And then it needs to make an offer that convinces them to take action. Something that people would feel silly saying no to.
